exponent_audit.claim: KTZ covering gives n=O(p/epsilon) and h=Omega(epsilon p).
exponent_audit.justification: Lemma 3.2 gives n<=3200(p+1)/epsilon<=6400p/epsilon and more than floor(epsilon p/100)/2 covered points per retained line.
Theta(D^3/d) available coefficients versus n(D+1) equations gives D^2=Theta(dn); inserting n=O(p/epsilon) yields the displayed upper scale.

exponent_audit.claim: Normal multiplicity costs Theta(s^2D) per graph without further qualification.
exponent_audit.justification: False over the theorem's entire stated parameter range. For d=D=101 and s>=102, C_s=N_d(D)=5254 while s^2D grows. The asymptotic is valid when D>=d(s-1), including P8's feasible n>D regime.

exponent_audit.claim: Multiplicity transfer cancels the factor s.
exponent_audit.justification: In the active regime, interpolation requires D=Theta(s sqrt(dn)), while transfer requires sh>D, hence h=Omega(sqrt(dn)).
From C_s>=s^2D/6, N_d(D)<=2D^3/d, and N_d(D)>nC_s, one gets D^2>dns^2/12; sh>D then gives the claim.

exponent_audit.claim: KTZ itself proves n=Theta(p/epsilon) and h=Theta(epsilon p).
exponent_audit.justification: KTZ provides only one-sided bounds. The cubic substitution is valid conditionally at simultaneous worst-case scales, but is not an unconditional lower bound for every KTZ cover.

exponent_audit.claim: Degeneracy removal and lifting impose no stronger exponent.
exponent_audit.justification: The source deletion budget is O(D/p+D^2/p^2), and lifting needs more than D incident lines. With D=O(sqrt(dp/epsilon)), D=O(epsilon p) again gives the cubic condition.

exponent_audit.claim: The verified exponent is stronger than 1/3.
exponent_audit.justification: It is exactly 1/3. Since 0<d/p<1, an improvement would require an exponent strictly larger than 1/3; none is proved.

line_audit.claim: The adapted coordinates are a two-sided filtered automorphism and define the intrinsic graph ideal.
line_audit.justification: The affine base-coordinate change is invertible, and both Z=P_M(T)+W and W=Z-P_M(T) preserve weights (1,1,d). Changing the transverse coordinate alters W only by an element divisible by S.

line_audit.claim: N_d(D) and C_s(D,d) are exact counts.
line_audit.justification: For integer D and s, the quotient basis consists exactly of T^rS^aW^b with a+b<s and r+a+db<=D.

line_audit.claim: The coefficient-versus-equation criterion yields a nonzero interpolant.
line_audit.justification: The constraints are homogeneous and have joint rank at most nC_s, so N_d(D)>nC_s leaves a nonzero kernel.

line_audit.claim: P4 correctly forces Z-dependence and the primitive degree cost.
line_audit.justification: A Z-independent solution is divisible by the s-th power of every distinct line equation. More generally, deg_Z A=zD this gives z>=s and D>=sd. D

line_audit.claim: P5 transfers graph multiplicity across a compatible intersection.
line_audit.justification: For M!=L, S_M restricts to a nonzero affine-linear polynomial with a simple zero, while compatibility makes W_M vanish there. Thus I_M^s pulls back into (t-t0)^s.
Distinct covered points give distinct parameters and coprime linear factors; deg A(L(t),P_L(t))<=D, so sh>D forces the formal zero polynomial.

line_audit.claim: P7's explicit D0 constant is correct.
line_audit.justification: For D>=d, N_d(D)>D^3/(16d) and C_s(D,d)<=s(s+1)D. The definition D0=floor(4sqrt(dns(s+1)))+1 makes the required inequality strict.
Under n>D, P4 activates every term in C_s and the stated lower and upper coefficient bounds yield h^2>dn/12.

line_audit.claim: All first derivatives vanish on an order-s graph for s>=2.
line_audit.justification: Every derivation maps I_M^s into I_M^(s-1), which lies in I_M when s>=2.

line_audit.claim: The abstract's unqualified Theta(s^2D) assertion holds throughout the theorem range.
line_audit.justification: It fails when s exceeds the available weighted monomial orders; C_s then saturates at N_d(D).

line_audit.claim: The exact KTZ insertion is fully quantified as a standalone module.
line_audit.justification: Its arithmetic is correct, but it should explicitly state that R and h come from KTZ Lemma 3.2 and record 0<epsilon<=1, n<=6400p/epsilon, and h>=h0.

line_audit.claim: The counterexample attempts support only the limitations claimed.
line_audit.justification: The examples correctly show failure of value-only transfer, vertical-only jets, multiplicity-preserving content removal, squarefree-to-simple-root inference, and D>=p separability. None is presented as a counterexample to P1-P8.

line_audit.claim: The global conclusion supplies one polynomial only through KTZ.
line_audit.justification: The submission explicitly disclaims a new decoder. KTZ Lemmas 6.2-6.3 provide one degree-d polynomial with agreement at least epsilon/8000 under the existing cubic hypothesis.

literature_audit.claim: KTZ Revision 1 proves the cubic benchmark under uniform incidence sampling.
literature_audit.justification: Theorem 1.1 applies over every finite field and yields one total-degree-at-most-d polynomial with agreement c epsilon; specialization to F_p and m=2 is valid.

literature_audit.claim: The explicit bivariate recovery constant is epsilon/8000.
literature_audit.justification: Lemma 6.2 gives component point measure at least epsilon/8000, and Lemma 6.3 supplies a single polynomial agreeing throughout that component.

literature_audit.claim: The KTZ covering constants and degree reconstruction are quoted accurately.
literature_audit.justification: Lemma 3.2 gives the stated cover bounds; Lemmas 2.2, 4.1-4.3 give the D=Theta(sqrt(dn)) construction and D=O(epsilon p) root budget.

literature_audit.claim: KTZ cleanup and global propagation require simple roots.
literature_audit.justification: Lemma 5.2 establishes B_Z(x,f(x))!=0 throughout the pruned graph; Lemma 6.1 performs initial lifting and Lemma 6.3 uses simple-root uniqueness for propagation.

literature_audit.claim: HKSS v1 uses Newton lifting and has the quoted weak bivariate parameters.
literature_audit.justification: Lemma 2.10 assumes a simple Z-root; Lemma 3.1 uses it. Theorem 4.2 assumes q>C d/epsilon^7 and concludes Omega(epsilon^4), while Theorem 1.4 leaves tau unspecified.
literature_audit.reference: [HKSS v1 PDF](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2311.12752v1), Lemmas 2.10 and 3.1; Theorems 1.4 and 4.2

literature_audit.claim: KTZ proves the simultaneous Theta scales used in the obstruction prose.
literature_audit.justification: It does not; those are a conditional worst-case parameter envelope, not a theorem of Lemma 3.2.

quantifier_audit.claim: The result covers every campaign parameter with prime p and integer 100<d<p.
quantifier_audit.justification: P1-P8 introduce no additional characteristic restriction beyond their explicitly conditional auxiliary hypotheses. No d<=100 case was used or scored.

quantifier_audit.claim: The theorem explicitly quantifies s and D as integers.
quantifier_audit.justification: Ideal powers, the exact codimension formula, and the monomial count require positive integer s and integer D, but line 0041 states only s>=1 and d<=D<p. The intended convention is clear but must be stated for an exact quantified claim.

quantifier_audit.claim: The line and point sampling convention is exact.
quantifier_audit.justification: There are p(p+1) unparameterized affine lines; choosing one uniformly and then one of its p points uniformly is exactly uniform sampling over p^2(p+1) incidences.

quantifier_audit.claim: Repeated, parallel, and concurrent witnesses are handled.
quantifier_audit.justification: R contains distinct lines, witnesses satisfy M!=L, and h counts distinct points. Parallel lines cannot witness an intersection, and multiple witnesses at one point contribute only one root.

quantifier_audit.claim: Every prime characteristic in the stated regime is handled.
quantifier_audit.justification: Graph multiplicity is defined by ideal powers/Hasse coefficients, so no factorial is inverted. D

quantifier_audit.claim: The advance is strictly bivariate and prime-field.
quantifier_audit.justification: The new proof uses X,Y and affine lines in F_p^2. KTZ is invoked only through its m=2 proof; HKSS's broader lemma is comparison-only. No extension-field result or dimension bootstrap supplies the advance.

quantifier_audit.claim: The KTZ-scale cubic conclusion is unconditional for every cover produced by Lemma 3.2.
quantifier_audit.justification: Only the one-sided bounds n=O(p/epsilon), h=Omega(epsilon p) are proved. The displayed Theta substitution must remain explicitly conditional or be supported by a saturation construction.

quantifier_audit.claim: The stated global conclusion converts to one polynomial.
quantifier_audit.justification: No new conversion is claimed. Under the quoted benchmark hypothesis, KTZ Lemmas 6.2-6.3 prove a single degree-d Q with agreement at least epsilon/8000.
